title: Ingested SAST finding row
description: Per-row contract enforced by triage/ingest.py before SQLite insert. Fields are the normalized output of the CSV → row pipeline; leftover source columns are preserved as scanner_meta_json.

scanner_finding_id.description: The scanner's own finding id. Not unique across scanners.

scanner_name.description: Which SAST produced the row (codeql, bandit, custom, …).

repo_url.description: Full clone URL — any GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket origin.

branch.description: Refspec the finding was reported against, e.g. `refs/heads/master`.

sha.description: Commit SHA the finding was reported at. The orchestrator anchors at this SHA — never HEAD.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the flagged file.

line.description: 1-based line number. 0 means the source did not expose a line.

description.description: Rule description / message — seeds the agent's first read.

scanner_url.description: Dashboard or ticket URL for this finding, if the scanner has one.

line_of_code_url.description: GitLab/GitHub/Bitbucket source URL with blob sha, path, and line fragment.
